MEDIA SETUP

1. Rickroll (required for the 90+ prank):
   public/media/rickroll.mp4

2. Optional post-reveal reaction videos:
   public/media/post-reveal/honors.mp4
   public/media/post-reveal/excellent.mp4
   public/media/post-reveal/pass.mp4
   public/media/post-reveal/warning.mp4
   public/media/post-reveal/fail.mp4

3. Optional post-reveal sounds:
   public/media/sounds/honors.mp3
   public/media/sounds/excellent.mp3
   public/media/sounds/pass.mp3
   public/media/sounds/warning.mp3
   public/media/sounds/fail.mp3

The app gracefully shows a fallback if optional files are missing.
